    PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => x) (fun x => x) g →
    ∀ (children : List Bool → List (List Bool)),
    (∀ x, g x =
      (children x).foldr (fun a b => List.replicate a.length true ++ false :: (a ++ b)) []) →
    ∃ run : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => x) (fun x => x) run ∧
      ∀ xs : List (List Bool),
        let consWord := fun a b : List Bool => List.replicate a.length true ++ false :: (a ++ b)
        run (xs.foldr consWord []) = (xs.flatMap children).foldr consWord []
